blocks.orig: The Wildlife Residence is a beautiful lodge surrounded by wildlife, at a 30-minute drive from Kilimanjaro International Airport and Arusha town. With views on Mount Kili and Mount Meru, this lodge is home to zebras, wildebeests, elands, kudus, and even the rare gerenuk! The rooms in this four-star hotel are well-equipped and decorated in a modern and comfortable style. Wildlife Residence is an eco-lodge with excellent food that goes from the field straight to your table. Vegetables and herbs are grown in their own kitchen garden and their dairy and meat products come from local farms. Lastly, if you want to stay active during your vacation, you can go horse riding, or even play games of polo or golf (all paid by card, as the lodge is completely cashless) while being surrounded by wildlife and breathtaking views at all times!
blocks.html: Just a 30-minute drive from Arusha town and Kilimanjaro International Airport, the Wildlife Residence is a lovely lodge where animals roam all around you. Mount Meru and Mount Kili are in view, and the grounds are shared with wildebeests, zebras, kudus, elands and even the rare gerenuk! This four-star hotel has rooms with good facilities and a contemporary, comfortable interior. As an eco-lodge, Wildlife Residence serves excellent farm-to-table food: the herbs and vegetables are grown in the lodge's own garden, and the meat and dairy come from farms in the area. Want to stay active while you are here? Try horse riding, or even a game of golf or polo (the lodge is fully cashless, so everything is paid by card), always with wildlife and stunning views close by!
